completed.title: Develop Data Generator Service

Create an in-memory mutable list to append incoming payloads from 'POST /update_match'. Implement mathematical logic processing loops for the 30-ball sliding-window momentum score, dynamic win probability truncation bounds (1-99%), and individual player impact ratings. Expose 'GET /get_analytics' to output the aggregated Highcharts-ready JSON structure.

Use 'st.columns' to create a 4-row responsive grid layout matching the visual specification. completed.verification_criteria: The UI compiles cleanly via 'streamlit run frontend/dashboard.py' without triggering cyclic layout reruns or layout fragmentation.

completed.title: Implement Highcharts Dynamic Components
completed.description: Embed Highcharts.js rendering via raw HTML injections using 'st.components.v1.html' or 'streamlit_highcharts'. Inject the target configurations for the Spline Line chart (Probability), Area Wave chart (Momentum), Donut Gauge (Boundary vs Dots), and Stacking Columns (Match Phases). Ensure the JavaScript arrays dynamically receive the continuous update variables fetched within the master polling loop inside 'st.empty()' blocks.
completed.verification_criteria: Charts cleanly animate and visually update data points smoothly every 2 seconds without visible full-screen flashing, UI blinking, or resetting user viewport positions.
